2607.17994.title: HAS: Highlight-guided Attention Steering for Multimodal LLM Video Summarization
2607.17994.paper_summary: Video understanding has become more and more important with the growth of Artificial Intelligence (AI) for video generation. Recently, Multimodal Large Language Model(M-LLM) has shown its capability in video understanding. Video summarization, a specific domain of video understanding, has proven its importance for efficient navigation and retrieval. Both video understanding and video summarization require a good selection of key frames in a video. Current video summarization methods heavily focus on the selected key frames and correlated segment captions. However, existing approaches overlook the perspective of treating the importance of the frames globally. We argue that using discrete selected frames for summarization will not only reduce the understanding coherence, but also lost important information in the video, as well as wasting the original capacity of the MLLMs. In this paper, we propose HAS, a Highlight-guided Attention Steering method for video summarization. We consider a challenging but practical setting where the video given to MLLMs for summarize should be continuous but with highlight guidance. HAS mainly consists of two parts: The first part is to find a continuous frame-level highlight distribution for the video globally. The second part is to apply the highlight distribution as an attention steering vector for the MLLM, targeting a better understanding of the video, and thus during the model inference time, putting more attention on the highlighted frames, while avoiding lost entire information on less highlighted frames through putting less attention instead of forgetting them. We evaluated HAS on a variety of benchmarks, and it has shown convincing performance in video summarization.
2607.17994.paper_summary_zh: 影片理解隨著人工智慧 (AI) 在影片生成方面的成長變得越來越重要。最近，多模態大型語言模型 (M-LLM) 展現了其在影片理解方面的能力。影片摘要作為影片理解的一個特定領域，已證明其在高效導航和檢索中的重要性。影片理解和影片摘要都需要對影片中的關鍵幀進行良好的選擇。目前的影片摘要方法主要集中在所選的關鍵幀和相關的片段標題上。然而，現有的方法忽略了從全局角度看待幀的重要性。我們認為，使用離散選定的幀進行摘要不僅會降低理解的一致性，還會損失影片中的重要信息，同時浪費 MLLMs 的原始能力。在本文中，我們提出了 HAS，一種以高亮引導的注意力引導方法，用於影片摘要。我們考慮了一個具有挑戰性但實用的設置，即提供給 MLLMs 進行摘要的影片應該是連續的，但需要高亮引導。HAS 主要由兩個部分組成：第一部分是為影片全球找到一個連續的幀級高亮分佈。第二部分是將高亮分佈應用為 MLLM 的注意力引導向量，旨在更好地理解影片，因此在模型推理期間，對高亮幀給予更多的注意，同時避免對較少高亮的幀失去整體信息，通過減少注意力而不是忘記它們。我們在多個基準上評估了 HAS，並且在影片摘要方面顯示出令人信服的表現。
